abstract: Covers the ECMAScript Temporal API (TC39), pinned to the Stage 4 Draft of July 27, 2026 with a build posture: Temporal finished stage 4 in March 2026 and is expected in ECMAScript 2027, but is not yet merged into the ECMA-262 draft. It lists three version lines: Temporal (ECMAScript 2027) as current, and as legacy lines ECMAScript Date and the Temporal pre-reduction polyfill API from before the June 2024 scope reduction, each with upgrade steps. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references cover versions and upgrades, the types and conversions, time zones, DST disambiguation and calendars, arithmetic and rounding, and RFC 9557 and RFC 3339 parsing, Intl formatting and Date migration.
